pages.text: Build a $(l)Barracks$(), then train units in $(l)Military → Recruit$(): footmen, shieldbearers (Drill), bowmen (Archery), crossbowmen (Crossbows), horsemen (Cavalry + Stables) and dragon riders.$(br2)They become real $(l)Villager Recruits$() soldiers owned by you.

$(l)Kits$() set what gear each unit type gets. $(l)Equip from the armoury$() hands every soldier the best kit the stockpile holds; old gear goes back into stores.$(br2)The town feeds and pays its garrison. Fed soldiers heal; hungry ones weaken.
